# Roam travel booking app (code.in.30s)
Destination explorer + booking mobile app. Soft glassmorphism + clean minimal: frosted translucent pills over photos (backdrop blur, white 20-30% fill, thin white border), 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips and search, soft diffuse shadows, Plus Jakarta Sans, thin rounded line icons, real travel photography (mountains, beaches, lakes, old towns). NO emoji, NO serif fonts, NO illustrations.
## Light: background white #FFFFFF with a frosted pale-sky gradient wash at the top (#E6F2FD to #F4F9FF to white). Cards white with soft blue-grey shadow. Ink #101C2C, secondary text #8A94A6. ONE azure accent gradient #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF for the active chip, primary CTA and active nav icon. Tiny accents only: coral #E8573A for heart/like, gold #F5B223 for rating stars.
